subject: Kokoro decoder length buckets
method: Inputs are zero-padded to the smallest bucket >= frames and noise extends the same seeded sequence. Every time-global or edge-sensitive op is restricted to the valid prefix at its resolution: InstanceNorm statistics, conv inputs (masked like zero padding), the reverse LSTM direction, the F0 phase interpolation edge (last valid value held over the padding), the harmonic STFT end reflection (10 samples written at the valid end) and the iSTFT frames and window envelope. The padded tail of the output is discarded.

exactness.float64_note: The masking is exact: in float64 the padded and unpadded valid prefixes agree to 1e-12.
exactness.float32_padded_vs_unpadded_rel_l2: 0 at exact bucket fits; 0.0027-0.0145 otherwise (same rounding amplification as the model's float32-vs-float64 floor of 0.007-0.025)
exactness.bit_identical: only when frames equals the bucket

cases.name: speed-bf_emma
cases.note: bucket already specialized by the previous case

native.cold_cache_isolation: The bundle was exported immediately before this run and had never been specialized, so each bucket's first use is a genuine cold specialization. No shared cache was cleared or redirected (Core AI exposes no per-process cache directory; the MPSGraph cache lives in the shared per-user cache).
native.lifecycle: cancellation recovery and active unload bit-identical; frames exact; repeats identical

bucketed_sweep.growth_within_a_bucket: none: footprint and Metal allocation stay flat across further lengths in an already used bucket

memory.scope: phys_footprint from task_info(TASK_VM_INFO) and MTLDevice.currentAllocatedSize of the default device, sampled after each call; MPSGraph's allocator caches may count toward the Metal figure after unload

timing.host_load: load averages 50-100 during every timing run on this shared host; GPU exclusive under the lock but CPU heavily contended
timing.conclusion: The bucketed graph's masking costs roughly 1.4-2.5x warm decode time at the same shape in these loaded runs, independent of padding; warm RTF on the parity cases was 0.12-0.19 here versus 0.031 for the unbucketed graph on a quieter host earlier the same day. A quiet-window interleaved remeasure is required before quoting a speed ratio.
